_help: The release schedule for toys (js/releases.js, the soon/ teaser page, middleware.js). Times are India time (+05:30). date: when the toy unlocks; change it here any time, no code needed. playableNow: true keeps a toy playable before its date (the launch day toys); its date is when Early Bird starts and it counts as launched. ready: set to true only once the toy is built and its card in data/home.json has a path; a toy that is not ready stays Coming soon even after its date. path: where the toy will live (its folder); middleware.js keeps that folder locked until release. hook: the one line used on cards, teasers, emails and posts. persona: who the toy is for (used for marketing). newDays: how many days a released toy shows the New sticker. To release a toy early or delay it without editing this file, use the Releases buttons in the admin dashboard. Builder tools and the Academy are not on this list and are always live.
